words.defn_en: without subsiding:continuous
words.root_note: un- (not) + ad- (to) + battere (to beat)

sentences.en: The storm continued ______ throughout the night, causing widespread flooding.
sentences.zh: 這場暴風雨整夜未曾減弱,造成大範圍淹水。

sentences.en: Despite the setback, her enthusiasm for the project remained ______.
sentences.zh: 儘管遭遇挫折,她對這項計畫的熱情絲毫未減。

words.defn_en: not influenced or changed; natural and sincere:
words.root_note: affect, from Latin afficere (to influence) + un-

sentences.en: Her voice remained ______ by the emotional weight of the news.
sentences.zh: 儘管這則消息帶有沉重的情感,她的聲音依然不受影響。

sentences.en: His ______ manner made him instantly likable to strangers.
sentences.zh: 他自然真誠的態度讓陌生人立刻對他產生好感。

words.defn_en: impossible to satisfy or calm:
words.defn_zh: 無法平息的;難以撫慰的
words.root_note: appease, from Old French apaisier + un-

sentences.en: His ______ hunger for power alienated even his closest allies.
sentences.zh: 他對權力那無法滿足的渴望甚至疏遠了他最親近的盟友。

sentences.en: The grieving mother's ______ sorrow lasted for years.
sentences.zh: 這位悲痛的母親那難以平息的哀傷持續了好幾年。

words.defn_en: not appealing, especially in terms of food:
words.root_note: appetite, from Latin appetere (to seek after) + un-

sentences.en: The cafeteria served a rather ______ gray stew that day.
sentences.zh: 那天,這間自助餐廳供應了一道相當倒胃口的灰色燉菜。

sentences.en: The description of the dish sounded surprisingly ______ .
sentences.zh: 這道菜的描述聽起來出乎意料地讓人沒有食慾。

words.defn_en: not friendly or easy to talk to:
words.root_note: approach, from Old French aprochier + un-

sentences.en: The new director seemed ______ during her first few weeks.
sentences.zh: 這位新任總監在她上任的頭幾週顯得難以接近。

sentences.en: He worried that his stern expression made him appear ______ .
sentences.zh: 他擔心自己嚴肅的表情讓他顯得難以親近。

words.defn_en: not pretentious or arrogant; modest:
words.root_note: assume, from Latin assumere (to take up) + un-

sentences.en: Despite his fame, he remained remarkably ______ and down-to-earth.
sentences.zh: 儘管聲名遠播,他依然出奇地謙遜且腳踏實地。

sentences.en: The restaurant had an ______ exterior that hid its excellent food.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳低調不張揚的外觀掩蓋了它美味的食物。

words.defn_en: not proven to be genuine or true:
words.defn_zh: 未經證實的;未經鑑定的
words.root_note: authenticate, from Greek authentikos (original, genuine) + un-

sentences.en: The museum refused to display the ______ artifact until further study.
sentences.zh: 這座博物館在進一步研究之前拒絕展出這件未經鑑定的文物。

sentences.en: Reporters were careful not to publish ______ claims about the incident.
sentences.zh: 記者們謹慎地避免發布關於這起事件未經證實的說法。

words.defn_en: not having official permission or approval:
words.root_note: authorize, from Latin auctor (author, originator) + un-

sentences.en: Security removed the ______ vehicle from the restricted area.
sentences.zh: 保全人員將這輛未經授權的車輛從這個限制區域移除。

sentences.en: The company took legal action against the ______ use of its logo.
sentences.zh: 這家公司對其商標遭未經授權的使用採取了法律行動。

words.defn_en: producing no useful result; ineffective:
words.root_note: avail, from Old French valoir (to be worth) + un-

sentences.en: Their efforts to revive the failing business proved ______ .
sentences.zh: 他們試圖挽救這家瀕臨倒閉企業的努力最終證實徒勞無功。

sentences.en: Despite his ______ protests, the decision was final.
sentences.zh: 儘管他抗議無效,這項決定依然是最終定案。

words.defn_en: having no knowledge of a situation or fact:
words.root_note: aware, from Old English gewær + un-

sentences.en: She remained ______ that her coworkers were planning a surprise party.
sentences.zh: 她一直不知道同事們正在籌劃一場驚喜派對。

sentences.en: He was completely ______ of the danger lurking just around the corner.
sentences.zh: 他完全沒有察覺到就在轉角處潛伏的危險。

words.defn_en: showing no prejudice for or against something; impartial:
words.root_note: bias, from Old French biais (slant) + un-

sentences.en: The judge was praised for her ______ handling of the difficult case.
sentences.zh: 這位法官因公正地處理這起棘手案件而受到讚揚。

sentences.en: Journalists strive to present an ______ account of the events.
sentences.zh: 記者們努力呈現這些事件公正無偏見的報導。

words.defn_en: uncontrolled or unrestrained:
words.root_note: bridle, from Old English bridel + un-

sentences.en: The crowd erupted in ______ joy when the final whistle blew.
sentences.zh: 終場哨聲響起時,群眾爆發出毫無節制的歡樂。

sentences.en: His ______ ambition eventually led to his downfall.
sentences.zh: 他不受約束的野心最終導致了他的垮台。

words.defn_en: not polite or courteous:
words.root_note: civil, from Latin civilis (relating to citizens) + un-

sentences.en: The customer's ______ remarks upset the young cashier.
sentences.zh: 這位顧客無禮的言論讓這位年輕的收銀員感到難過。

sentences.en: Debate rules were introduced after several ______ exchanges in previous sessions.
sentences.zh: 在先前幾場會議出現無禮的言語交鋒之後,便引入了辯論規則。

words.defn_en: unwilling to make concessions; firm in one's position:
words.defn_zh: 不妥協的;堅定不讓步的
words.root_note: compromise, from Latin compromittere (to make a mutual promise) + un-

sentences.en: The union took an ______ stance on the proposed wage cuts.
sentences.zh: 這個工會對這項提議的減薪方案採取了不妥協的立場。

sentences.en: Her ______ dedication to quality set the company apart from competitors.
sentences.zh: 她對品質不妥協的堅持讓這家公司在競爭對手中脫穎而出。

words.defn_en: not hidden; open and obvious:
words.root_note: conceal, from Latin concelare (to hide completely) + un-

sentences.en: Her ______ disappointment was evident to everyone in the room.
sentences.zh: 她未加掩飾的失望讓房間裡的每個人都看得一清二楚。

sentences.en: He watched the announcement with ______ excitement.
sentences.zh: 他帶著毫不掩飾的興奮觀看這則宣布。

words.defn_en: unreasonable, unjust:
words.root_note: un- (not) + con- (with) + scire (to know)

sentences.en: Charging that much for a bottle of water is simply ______.
sentences.zh: 為一瓶水收取那麼高的費用實在毫無道理。

sentences.en: It would be ______ to fire her without any warning.
sentences.zh: 毫無預警就解僱她,實在是說不過去。

words.defn_en: not restrained, regulated, or checked:
words.root_note: control, from Old French contreroller + un-

sentences.en: The wildfire spread ______ across thousands of acres.
sentences.zh: 這場野火失控地蔓延了數千英畝的土地。

sentences.en: His ______ temper often caused problems at work.
sentences.zh: 他無法控制的脾氣經常在工作上引發問題。

words.defn_en: not based on or conforming to conventional or accepted standards:
words.root_note: convention, from Latin convenire (to come together) + un-

sentences.en: The architect was known for her bold, ______ designs.
sentences.zh: 這位建築師以她大膽、不落俗套的設計聞名。

sentences.en: He took an ______ approach to solving the budget crisis.
sentences.zh: 他採取了一種非傳統的方式來解決這場預算危機。

words.defn_en: not developed or refined; not farmed:
words.root_note: cultivate, from Latin cultivare (to till) + un-

sentences.en: Vast stretches of ______ land stretched beyond the village.
sentences.zh: 大片未開墾的土地延伸到這座村莊之外。

sentences.en: Critics considered his taste in art rather ______ .
sentences.zh: 評論家認為他在藝術上的品味相當缺乏修養。

words.defn_en: lacking good taste, education, or refinement:
words.defn_zh: 沒有文化素養的;粗俗的
words.root_note: culture, from Latin cultura (cultivation) + un-

sentences.en: She felt ______ compared to her well-traveled colleagues.
sentences.zh: 與她那些見多識廣的同事相比,她覺得自己缺乏文化素養。

sentences.en: He was mocked for his ______ remarks at the art gallery opening.
sentences.zh: 他在這場藝廊開幕式上粗俗的言論遭到了嘲笑。

words.defn_en: not showing feelings or emotions openly:
words.root_note: demonstrative, from Latin demonstrare (to show) + un-

sentences.en: Her ______ nature made it hard to know when she was truly upset.
sentences.zh: 她內斂不外露情感的性格讓人很難察覺她何時真正感到難過。

sentences.en: Though ______ in public, he was deeply affectionate with his family at home.
sentences.zh: 儘管他在公開場合顯得內斂,但在家中對家人卻十分深情。

words.defn_en: lacking good judgment or the ability to perceive distinctions:
words.root_note: discern, from Latin discernere (to separate, distinguish) + un-

sentences.en: An ______ buyer might easily be fooled by the counterfeit goods.
sentences.zh: 一個缺乏辨別力的買家可能很容易被這些仿冒商品所矇騙。

sentences.en: The critic accused mainstream audiences of being ______ about quality filmmaking.
sentences.zh: 這位評論家指責主流觀眾在評判優質電影方面缺乏辨別力。

words.defn_en: lacking careful judgment; not distinguishing between different qualities:
words.root_note: discriminate, from Latin discriminare (to divide, distinguish) + un-

sentences.en: His ______ taste in music meant he enjoyed almost anything played.
sentences.zh: 他不加區別的音樂品味讓他幾乎什麼歌都能欣賞。

sentences.en: The store catered to ______ shoppers looking for the cheapest option.
sentences.zh: 這家商店迎合了那些不挑剔、只想找到最便宜選項的顧客。

words.defn_en: to remove one's clothes; a state of being unclothed:
words.root_note: dress, from Old French drecier (to arrange) + un-

sentences.en: The child began to ______ hurriedly before jumping into the pool.
sentences.zh: 這個孩子在跳進泳池前急忙脫掉衣服。

sentences.en: The soldier was caught partially in a state of ______ during the surprise inspection.
sentences.zh: 這名士兵在這場突襲檢查中被發現處於半裸露的狀態。

words.defn_en: a feeling of anxiety or discomfort:
words.root_note: ease, from Old French aise (comfort) + un- + -ness

sentences.en: A growing ______ settled over the office after the layoffs were announced.
sentences.zh: 在裁員消息公布後,一股日益增長的不安籠罩了整間辦公室。

sentences.en: She couldn't shake the ______ she felt about the upcoming interview.
sentences.zh: 她無法擺脫她對即將到來的面試所感到的不安。

words.defn_en: not showing or influenced by emotion:
words.root_note: emotion, from Latin emovere (to move out, stir up) + un-

sentences.en: The judge remained ______ while delivering the difficult verdict.
sentences.zh: 這位法官在宣布這項艱難的判決時始終不動聲色。

sentences.en: His ______ response to the tragedy surprised his friends.
sentences.zh: 他對這場悲劇不帶感情的反應讓他的朋友們感到驚訝。

words.defn_en: lacking knowledge, understanding, or modern views:
words.root_note: enlighten, from Old English inlihtan + un-

sentences.en: The policy reflected an ______ view of mental health treatment.
sentences.zh: 這項政策反映了對心理健康治療缺乏理解的觀點。

sentences.en: He was criticized for holding ______ opinions about gender roles.
sentences.zh: 他因抱持著關於性別角色未開化的觀點而受到批評。

words.defn_en: not disturbed or disconcerted:
words.defn_zh: 不為所動的;鎮定自若的
words.root_note: faze, of uncertain dialectal origin, related to feeze (to frighten) + un-

sentences.en: She remained ______ by the harsh criticism during the review.
sentences.zh: 她在這場評審中面對嚴厲的批評依然鎮定自若。

sentences.en: The veteran pilot was ______ by the sudden turbulence.
sentences.zh: 這位經驗豐富的飛行員面對突如其來的亂流絲毫不為所動。

words.defn_en: to free from restraint or restriction:
words.root_note: fetter, from Old English feter (shackle) + un-

sentences.en: The new policy aims to ______ small businesses from excessive regulation.
sentences.zh: 這項新政策旨在解除過度法規對小型企業的束縛。

sentences.en: She felt ______ ed once she finally left the toxic relationship.
sentences.zh: 她終於離開這段有害的關係後,感到自己解脫了束縛。

words.defn_en: not restrained or restricted; free:
words.root_note: past participle of unfetter, from Old English feter (shackle) + un-

sentences.en: The artist enjoyed ______ creative freedom on this project.
sentences.zh: 這位藝術家在這項計畫中享有不受束縛的創作自由。

sentences.en: Critics warned against ______ corporate power in the marketplace.
sentences.zh: 評論家警告不要讓企業在市場上擁有不受約束的權力。

words.defn_en: impossible to control or restrain:
words.defn_zh: 難以管束的;無法控制的
words.root_note: govern, from Latin gubernare (to steer, direct) + un-

sentences.en: The toddler's ______ tantrums exhausted his parents.
sentences.zh: 這個幼兒難以管束的鬧脾氣讓他的父母筋疲力盡。

sentences.en: The region became increasingly ______ after the collapse of central authority.
sentences.zh: 在中央政府權威瓦解之後,這個地區變得越來越難以控制。

words.defn_en: mentally unstable or unbalanced:
words.root_note: hinge, from Middle English henge + un-, describing a door off its hinges

sentences.en: He seemed completely ______ after losing everything in the fire.
sentences.zh: 他在這場大火中失去一切後,顯得完全崩潰失常。

sentences.en: The character's ______ behavior grows more disturbing throughout the play.
sentences.zh: 這個角色失常的行為在整齣戲劇中變得越來越令人不安。

words.defn_en: beyond doubt or reproach; unquestionable:
words.defn_zh: 無可指摘的;不容置疑的
words.root_note: impeach, from Latin impedicare (to entangle, fetter) + un-

sentences.en: Her ______ integrity made her the ideal candidate for the position.
sentences.zh: 她無可指摘的正直讓她成為這個職位的理想人選。

sentences.en: The witness provided ______ evidence that settled the case.
sentences.zh: 這位證人提供了無可置疑的證據,使這起案件得以定案。

words.defn_en: lacking creativity, originality, or enthusiasm:
words.root_note: inspire, from Latin inspirare (to breathe into) + un-

sentences.en: Critics called the sequel ______ and derivative of the original.
sentences.zh: 評論家認為這部續集缺乏靈感,只是原作的翻版。

sentences.en: The team delivered an ______ performance in the second half.
sentences.zh: 這支隊伍在下半場的表現顯得平庸乏味。

words.defn_en: lacking intelligence; not showing good judgment:
words.root_note: intelligent, from Latin intelligere (to understand) + un-

sentences.en: The plan seemed ______ given the obvious risks involved.
sentences.zh: 考量到其中明顯的風險,這項計畫顯得相當不明智。

sentences.en: It would be ______ to ignore the warning signs entirely.
sentences.zh: 完全忽視這些警訊將會是愚笨的做法。

words.defn_en: not interested; lacking curiosity or concern:
words.root_note: interest, from Latin interesse (to be between) + un-

sentences.en: He seemed ______ in the details of the merger.
sentences.zh: 他對這次合併的細節似乎不感興趣。

sentences.en: Students grew ______ once the lecture ran past an hour.
sentences.zh: 這場講座拖過一個小時後,學生們開始變得意興闌珊。

words.defn_en: untidy, neglected:
words.root_note: un- (not) + kempt (combed)

sentences.en: His ______ beard made him look older than he was.
sentences.zh: 他那蓬亂的鬍子讓他看起來比實際年齡更老。

sentences.en: The garden had grown ______ after months of neglect.
sentences.zh: 這座花園在疏於照料數月後變得雜草叢生、雜亂無章。

words.defn_en: difficult or impossible to control or handle:
words.defn_zh: 難以管理的;難以駕馭的
words.root_note: manage, from Italian maneggiare (to handle) + un-

sentences.en: The workload became ______ once two team members quit.
sentences.zh: 在兩名團隊成員離職後,這份工作量變得難以應付。

sentences.en: Her curly hair was ______ in the humid weather.
sentences.zh: 在這種潮濕的天氣裡,她的捲髮變得難以整理。

words.defn_en: unrelieved, as bad as can be:
words.root_note: un- (not) + mitigare (to soften)

sentences.en: The concert was an ______ disaster from start to finish.
sentences.zh: 這場演唱會從頭到尾都是一場徹頭徹尾的災難。

sentences.en: His plan turned out to be an ______ failure.
sentences.zh: 他的計畫結果證明是一場徹底的失敗。

words.defn_en: contrary to nature or normal expectations; forced:
words.root_note: natural, from Latin naturalis (relating to nature) + un-

sentences.en: Her smile seemed ______ and forced during the photo shoot.
sentences.zh: 她在這場拍照過程中的笑容顯得不自然又勉強。

sentences.en: Scientists studied the ______ silence in the forest after the wildfire.
sentences.zh: 科學家研究了這場野火之後這片森林裡那種反常的寂靜。

words.defn_en: inconspicuous; not easily noticed
words.root_note: un- (not) + ob- (against) + trudere (to push)

sentences.en: She preferred an ______ style of decoration, nothing too flashy.
sentences.zh: 她偏好低調不張揚的裝飾風格,不喜歡太過花俏的東西。

sentences.en: The security cameras were designed to be ______ yet effective.
sentences.zh: 這些監視攝影機的設計既不張揚又能發揮效用。

words.defn_en: not conforming to accepted or usual standards:
words.root_note: orthodoxos (right opinion), from Greek orthos (correct) + doxa (opinion) + un-

sentences.en: The coach's ______ training methods surprised many veteran players.
sentences.zh: 這位教練非傳統的訓練方法讓許多資深球員感到驚訝。

sentences.en: She pursued an ______ career path, skipping college entirely.
sentences.zh: 她走上了一條非傳統的職涯道路,完全跳過了大學教育。

words.defn_en: not showy or designed to attract attention:
words.root_note: ostentatio (a showing), from Latin ostendere (to show) + un-

sentences.en: The billionaire lived in a surprisingly ______ house.
sentences.zh: 這位億萬富翁住在一棟出乎意料樸實不張揚的房子裡。

sentences.en: Her ______ generosity was known only to those closest to her.
sentences.zh: 她那不張揚的慷慨只有最親近她的人知道。

words.defn_en: not pleasant to taste; difficult to accept:
words.defn_zh: 難以下嚥的;難以接受的
words.root_note: palatable, from Latin palatum (palate) + un-

sentences.en: The overcooked vegetables were nearly ______ .
sentences.zh: 這些煮過頭的蔬菜幾乎讓人難以下嚥。

sentences.en: The report presented some ______ truths about the company's finances.
sentences.zh: 這份報告呈現了一些關於這家公司財務難以接受的真相。

words.defn_en: having no equal or match:
words.root_note: parallel, from Greek parallelos (beside one another) + un-

sentences.en: The museum houses an ______ collection of ancient artifacts.
sentences.zh: 這座博物館收藏了一批無與倫比的古代文物。

sentences.en: Her success in the field remains ______ to this day.
sentences.zh: 她在這個領域的成就至今依然無人能及。

words.defn_en: not disturbed or agitated; calm:
words.root_note: perturb, from Latin perturbare (to throw into confusion) + un-

sentences.en: She remained ______ despite the chaos unfolding around her.
sentences.zh: 儘管周圍一片混亂,她依然保持鎮靜。

sentences.en: The captain stayed ______ as the storm intensified.
sentences.zh: 隨著這場暴風雨加劇,這位船長依然鎮定自若。

words.defn_en: not refined or finished; lacking sophistication:
words.root_note: polish, from Latin polire (to smooth) + un-

sentences.en: The manuscript was still ______ but showed great promise.
sentences.zh: 這份手稿雖然還未經雕琢,卻展現出極大的潛力。

sentences.en: His ______ manners occasionally embarrassed his more refined colleagues.
sentences.zh: 他未經修飾的舉止偶爾會讓他那些更為文雅的同事感到尷尬。

words.defn_en: novel; unparalleled
words.root_note: un- (not) + prae- (before) + cedere (to go)

sentences.en: The pandemic caused ______ disruptions to the global economy.
sentences.zh: 這場疫情對全球經濟造成了前所未有的衝擊。

sentences.en: Ticket sales reached ______ levels for the reunion concert.
sentences.zh: 這場重聚演唱會的票券銷售達到了空前的水準。

words.defn_en: not attractive or impressive in appearance:
words.root_note: prepossess, from pre- (before) + possess, from Latin possidere + un-

sentences.en: The ______ building housed one of the city's best restaurants.
